meet.landingBody: Private calls on Zentico's own servers. Start a meeting and share the link with anyone in your workspace.
meet.invalidCode: That doesn't look like a meeting code. Codes look like abc-defg-hij.
meet.notConfiguredHint: Ask your administrator to connect a LiveKit server (LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET).
meet.connectFailed: We couldn't connect to the meeting server. Check your connection and try again.
meet.permissionDenied: Camera or microphone access is blocked. Allow it from the address bar and reload — you can still join without them.
meet.noDevices: No camera or microphone found. You can still join and use chat.
meet.noCamera: No camera found. You can join with audio only.
meet.noMic: No microphone found. Others won't be able to hear you.
meet.deviceBusy: Your camera or microphone is in use by another app.
meet.insecureContext: Camera and microphone need a secure (HTTPS) connection.
meet.audioBlocked: Your browser paused the call audio.
meet.chatUnread: Chat, {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}
meet.chatEmpty: Messages are only visible to people in the call and disappear when it ends.
meet.leftDuplicate: You joined this meeting from another tab or device
meet.leftLost: You were disconnected from the meeting
meet.recNoticeSelf: Everyone in this call is notified. Each person's audio is recorded and transcribed on Zentico's servers.
meet.recNotice: {name} is recording this call. Your audio is recorded and transcribed on Zentico's servers.
meet.recStartedSelf: Recording started. Everyone in the call has been notified.
meet.rec_busy: Someone else is already recording this call
meet.rec_startFailed: Couldn't start the recording. Try again.
meet.rec_uploadFailed: Recording stopped: audio couldn't be uploaded
meet.rec_tooLarge: Recording stopped: it reached the size limit
meet.recDeleteConfirm: Delete this recording and its audio for everyone? A copy already saved to Drive is kept.
meet.recInProgress: This meeting is still being recorded.
meet.recProcessing: Transcribing… This page updates by itself.
meet.recErrNotConfigured: Transcription isn't configured on this server. The audio is saved; retry once an administrator sets up the Whisper service.
meet.recErrTranscription: Transcription failed. The audio is saved, so you can retry.
meet.recErrDriveSession: The transcript is ready, but it couldn't be saved to Drive because the session expired. Retry to save it.
meet.recErrDrive: The transcript is ready, but it couldn't be saved to Drive. Retry to save it.
meet.recNoSpeech: No speech was detected in this recording.
